name: Nook
description:
Your smart home from the top bar: lights, plugs, sensors, cameras, air conditioners, TVs and speakers.

Works with Home Assistant, Philips Hue, HomeKit, Smart Life, Mi Home, eWeLink and air conditioner clouds; on the local network with Gree, Midea and Daikin air conditioners, Tapo cameras, Sonoff switches, Cast speakers and most smart TVs. Pairing an Android TV needs openssl.

While the screen is locked Nook calls no clouds and only turns leak and smoke alerts from a Xiaomi gateway into notifications.

The copy button next to a donation address in the settings puts it on the clipboard; Nook reads nothing from it.
